newsitem.title: FRANCE: French judge probes three ex-government ministers.
newsitem.headline: French judge probes three ex-government ministers.

text.p: A French judge has placed three centrist former government ministers under investigation in a probe into illicit party funding, justice sources said on Wednesday.

They said Jacques Barrot, labour minister in the outgoing government, former justice minister Pierre Mehaignerie and former transport minister Bernard Bosson were placed under investigation by Paris judge Jean-Pierre Zanoto on Monday.

The three former members of the Force Democrate party, as well as a former treasurer of the group which is part of the Union for French Democracy (UDF), were suspected of illicit party financing, the sources said.
The sources said Jean Arthuis, finance minister in the outgoing government, had been initially mentioned but the judge was considering clearing him because his role in the party had been too minor.
The centre-right, made up of the Gaullist RPR and the UDF, was defeated in a parliamentary election on Sunday which brought a leftist bloc led by the Socialists to power.
